dataset: SAFE-Loop Input validation / sanitization set (hard) v0.2
test_layout: 12 tests per task; tests 1-6 = visible pool, tests 7-12 = fixed hidden set; every test is labelled hard; visible tests are not shown when runner uses k=0.
notes: Built from the supplied validation_hard file: original VAL-001..008 are preserved, with their test levels normalized to hard, and VAL-009..030 add 22 standards-oriented validation tasks. Every task has 12 positional-argument tests with returns/ValueError expectations, no reference_solution field, and 6 visible-pool plus 6 hidden tests. The generated JSON and schema have been checked. New test expectations come from local deterministic reference implementations and were spot-checked against standard library behavior; not every task has yet received a full separate implementation cross-check or typical-mistake test. No target model run has been performed, so a first-attempt pass rate below 50% is not guaranteed and must be measured empirically.

tasks.title: Resolve a relative URI (RFC 3986 section 5)
tasks.signature: def resolve_uri(base: str, ref: str) -> str
tasks.prompt: Write `resolve_uri(base, ref)` that resolves the URI reference `ref` against the absolute URI `base` exactly as RFC 3986 section 5 specifies (strict parser, no backward-compatibility exceptions), and returns the resulting URI. Raise `ValueError` if `base` has no scheme. Do not import urllib.

tasks.title: Strict IPv4 address
tasks.prompt: Write `parse_ipv4(text)` that parses an IPv4 address written as four decimal numbers separated by dots, using the `IPv4address` rule of RFC 3986 (the `dec-octet` grammar), and returns the 4 bytes as lower-case hex. Raise `ValueError` for anything that does not match that grammar exactly. Do not import ipaddress or socket.

tasks.title: Strict IPv6 address
tasks.prompt: Write `parse_ipv6(text)` that parses an IPv6 address in the text forms of RFC 4291 section 2.2 (full, with `::` compression, and with a trailing dotted IPv4 part) and returns the 16 bytes as lower-case hex. Hex digits may be in either case. Raise `ValueError` for anything else, including zone identifiers such as `%eth0`, prefix lengths, and any IPv4 part that is not a strict RFC 3986 `IPv4address`. Do not import ipaddress or socket.

tasks.title: Is this IP address inside this CIDR block?
tasks.signature: def ip_in_cidr(ip: str, cidr: str) -> bool
tasks.prompt: Write `ip_in_cidr(ip, cidr)` that returns True if the IPv4 or IPv6 address `ip` lies inside the network `cidr` written as `address/prefix-length`. Both parts must be strictly valid (the prefix is decimal digits only, no leading zeros, within the address size, and the network address must have no host bits set), otherwise raise `ValueError`. An IPv4 address is never inside an IPv6 network or the other way round (return False, including IPv4-mapped IPv6 forms). Do not import ipaddress or socket.

tasks.title: Valid host name
tasks.prompt: Write `is_valid_hostname(name)` that returns True if `name` is a valid host name under RFC 1123 section 2.1 and RFC 3696 section 2 (letters, digits and hyphens, with the label, total-length and last-label rules those documents give). One trailing dot is allowed. Return False for anything else, including non-ASCII text.

tasks.title: Punycode encoder (RFC 3492)
tasks.prompt: Write `punycode_encode(label)` that encodes a Unicode string with Punycode as defined in RFC 3492 and returns the ASCII result without the `xn--` prefix (for an all-ASCII input the result is the input followed by `-`). Implement the Bootstring algorithm yourself: do not use the `punycode` or `idna` codecs or modules.

tasks.title: Punycode decoder (RFC 3492)
tasks.prompt: Write `punycode_decode(text)` that decodes Punycode text (RFC 3492, without the `xn--` prefix) back to a Unicode string. Digits may be upper or lower case. Raise `ValueError` for any invalid input: a non-ASCII character, a character that is not a Punycode digit, truncated data, or a result beyond U+10FFFF. Implement the Bootstring algorithm yourself: do not use the `punycode` or `idna` codecs or modules.

tasks.title: UUID version and variant
tasks.prompt: Write `uuid_info(text)` that returns `[version, variant]` for a UUID written in the canonical 8-4-4-4-12 hyphenated form (hex digits in either case): the version is the 4-bit version field (0 to 15) and the variant is one of `"ncs"`, `"rfc4122"`, `"microsoft"`, `"reserved"` as defined in RFC 9562 section 4.1. Raise `ValueError` for any other spelling (braces, `urn:uuid:`, missing hyphens, extra whitespace). Do not import uuid.

tasks.title: RFC 3339 timestamp validation and UTC normalization
tasks.prompt: Implement the timestamp profile in RFC 3339 and return its Unix microseconds, original UTC offset in minutes, and canonical UTC timestamp. Raise ValueError for invalid input.

tasks.title: Semantic Versioning precedence comparator
tasks.signature: def compare_semver(a: str, b: str) -> int
tasks.prompt: Compare versions under Semantic Versioning 2.0.0. Return -1, 0, or 1 according to precedence; raise ValueError for malformed versions.

tasks.title: IBAN normalization and MOD-97 validation
tasks.prompt: Validate and normalize an International Bank Account Number according to ISO 13616. Return its uppercase form without visual ASCII spaces; raise ValueError if invalid.

tasks.title: Strict UTF-8 decoding from hexadecimal bytes
tasks.prompt: Decode the supplied byte sequence as strict UTF-8 per RFC 3629. Raise ValueError for malformed hex, overlong encodings, surrogate code points, out-of-range values, and truncated sequences.

tasks.title: Canonical unpadded Base64url decoder
tasks.prompt: Decode the URL-safe Base64 representation in RFC 4648 and return bytes as lowercase hex. Accept the canonical unpadded form only; raise ValueError otherwise.

tasks.title: JSON Pointer token decoding
tasks.prompt: Decode the reference tokens of a JSON Pointer (RFC 6901). Return the token list and reject invalid escape sequences or invalid pointer syntax with ValueError.

tasks.title: Strict form-urlencoded query parser
tasks.prompt: Parse an application/x-www-form-urlencoded query into ordered key/value pairs. Preserve duplicate and empty fields; decode percent escapes as UTF-8 and interpret plus signs as spaces. Raise ValueError on invalid escapes or UTF-8.

tasks.title: Strict JSON Lines stream parser
tasks.prompt: Parse a newline-delimited JSON stream. Return records in order; reject blank records, malformed JSON, duplicate object keys, non-standard constants, and bare carriage returns.

tasks.title: Strict RFC 8259 JSON number parser
tasks.prompt: Validate a JSON number under RFC 8259 and return [sign_bit, coefficient_digits, decimal_exponent] without rounding. Raise ValueError for non-number tokens.

tasks.title: XML 1.0 text escaping and character validation
tasks.prompt: Escape XML text content under the XML 1.0 character rules. Reject characters that cannot appear in an XML 1.0 document with ValueError.

tasks.title: RFC 3986 URI path-segment encoder
tasks.prompt: Percent-encode a single UTF-8 URI path segment using RFC 3986 unreserved characters. Do not treat plus as a space; emit uppercase hexadecimal escapes.

tasks.title: Strict media type and parameter parser
tasks.prompt: Parse a MIME media type and its parameters as defined by HTTP field syntax. Return lowercase type/subtype and a parameter map; reject malformed quoting and duplicate parameter names.

tasks.title: HTTP Content-Range validator
tasks.prompt: Parse an HTTP Content-Range value using the byte-range grammar. Return [unit, start, end, complete_length], using null fields for an unsatisfied range. Raise ValueError for invalid ranges.

tasks.title: Strict IMF-fixdate parser
tasks.prompt: Parse an IMF-fixdate HTTP date as defined by RFC 9110 and return its Unix timestamp in seconds. Reject obsolete date formats and weekday/date mismatches.

tasks.title: Retry-After value parser
tasks.signature: def parse_retry_after(value: str, now: int) -> dict
tasks.prompt: Parse Retry-After according to HTTP semantics. Return either a delay-seconds record or an HTTP-date record with epoch and nonnegative delay; raise ValueError for invalid values.

tasks.title: Strict URI authority host and port parser
tasks.prompt: Parse a restricted RFC 3986 authority containing only a host and optional port (userinfo is not accepted). Return host, integer port or null, and host kind (name, ipv4, ipv6). Raise ValueError for invalid syntax.

tasks.title: Content-Disposition and RFC 5987 filename parser
tasks.prompt: Parse an HTTP Content-Disposition field, including extended filename parameters per RFC 6266 and RFC 5987. Return disposition, parameters, and the preferred filename; raise ValueError for malformed fields.

tasks.title: Strict quoted-printable body decoder
tasks.prompt: Decode a quoted-printable body according to RFC 2045 and return lowercase hex. Treat CRLF soft line breaks correctly; reject malformed escapes and illegal line endings.

tasks.title: BCP 47 language-tag canonicalizer
tasks.prompt: Validate a well-formed language tag using the subtag grammar of RFC 5646 and return canonical casing. Raise ValueError for malformed or duplicate variants/extensions.

tasks.title: RFC 2397 data URI parser
tasks.prompt: Parse a data URI as specified by RFC 2397. Return [media_type, parameters, payload_hex]; raise ValueError for malformed metadata, escapes, or Base64 data.

tasks.title: RFC 3986 IPvFuture literal parser
tasks.prompt: Parse the IP-literal IPvFuture syntax in RFC 3986. Return [numeric_version, address_text] and reject invalid brackets, versions, or address characters.

tasks.title: RFC 2047 MIME encoded-word decoder
tasks.prompt: Decode RFC 2047 encoded words in a header value using Base64 or Q encoding. Support UTF-8, US-ASCII, and ISO-8859-1; reject malformed encoded words or invalid byte sequences.
